# War Scroll Column 11 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** 1QM (Cave 1), Col. 11 | **Condition:** complete

---

**11:1** You are an awe-inspiring God, throned in glory within Your kingdom, and the assembly of Your holy ones stands in our midst as our eternal help. We will heap contempt upon kings and pour out scorn and mockery on

**11:2** the powerful. For the Lord is holy! The King of Glory fights at our side, along with His holy ones. Heaven's fiercest warriors are counted in our ranks,

**11:3** and the Divine Warrior stands within our assembly; the army of His spirits marches in our footsteps. Our cavalry sweeps in like storm clouds,

**11:4** like morning dew blanketing the earth, like a downpour of rain drenching the ground with justice wherever life grows. Rise up, you

**11:5** who lie in the dust! You who are food for worms, stand up to face the battle! Arm yourselves and take your stand! For who can compare with Your people Israel, whom You chose

**11:6** for Yourself out of every nation on earth? A people set apart by covenant, trained in God's instruction, gifted with insight,

**11:7** who hear the voice of the Glorious One and see the holy angels face to face, whose ears are opened wide to hear mysteries and perceive the plan that spans

**11:8** all the ages. We heap contempt upon kings and pour scorn and mockery upon the mighty. For the Lord

**11:9** is holy, and the King of Glory fights alongside us with His holy ones. Heaven's mightiest warriors are enlisted among us, and the Divine

**11:10** Warrior stands in our assembly; the army of His spirits marches with us step by step. Our cavalry sweeps in like clouds, like morning

**11:11** dew blanketing the land, like a cloudburst drenching the ground with justice everywhere it falls. The God of Israel has drawn

**11:12** the sword against every nation, and through the holy ones of His people He will accomplish mighty deeds. Rise, O Warrior God! Seize

**11:13** Your prisoners, O Glorious One! Claim Your plunder, O Champion! Plant Your hand on the necks of Your enemies

**11:14** and set Your foot upon the piles of their dead. Crush the nations that oppose You, and let Your blade consume

**11:15** their guilty flesh. Fill Your land with splendor and Your heritage with blessing; may livestock overflow in Your pastures,

**11:16** silver and gold and jewels fill Your palaces. Rejoice with all your heart, O Zion! Break out in joyful song,

**11:17** O Jerusalem! Celebrate, every city of Judah! Throw open your gates forever, so that the wealth of the nations may pour into you. Their kings will serve you, every one of your oppressors will bow at your feet, and they will grovel in the dust before you. The victory belongs to You alone, and the outcome of every battle rests in Your hand.

---

*PNEUMA notes: Column 11 is the climactic victory hymn of the War Scroll. The liturgical repetition (lines 1-4 paralleled in 8-11) has been preserved to maintain the chanting rhythm. "Hero of War" rendered as "Divine Warrior" to capture the theological force for modern readers. The closing echoes Isaiah 60 and Psalm 24. Vivid martial imagery rendered with contemporary force.*
